sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:30 – 14:30)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 5 sets of keys, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam.
Alpha Route commenced. Welfare check along Starbucks, all clear. Patrolling down Queen Street making our presence visible to the stores open at this time.
Arrived at the corner of Queen Street and Wyndham Street; area thoroughly checked, all clear.
Arrived at the corner of Queen Street and Shortland Street; area thoroughly checked, all clear.
Pocket Park cleared of any vagrants or issues.
Welfare check inside Imperial Lane; floor checks completed, no issues visible.
Response call from Sky Mart Convenience Store reporting a suspicious male individual inside the store; immediate assistance requested in case of possible theft.

Arrived at the response location, Sky Mart Convenience Store; standing by discreetly outside in case the individual attempted to steal. The individual reported purchased the items and left the store without further issues.
Arrived at the check-in at the top of Victoria Street; welfare checks commenced along all stores, all clear. Ensuring our presence is visible while remaining stationed here.
Continuing patrols and making our way to the next checkpoint.
Welfare check along Woolworths Victoria Street, all clear.
Walkthrough completed along Elliott Street, no issues found.
Arrived at the Aotea Square check-in; full scope of the location ensuring no vagrants or problems, all clear. Standing by to ensure our presence is known while awaiting response calls.
Continuing patrols, no concerns identified; patrolling down Queen Street to the next checkpoint.
Welfare check along Remedy Coffee, all clear.
Welfare check along Mrs Higgins, McDonald's Queen Street, 77 Convenience Store and Mid City, all clear. Remaining stationed here until further concerns arise.
Continuing patrols down to the next checkpoint.
Arrived at the corner of Queen Street and Victoria Street, all clear.
Arrived at the Commercial Bay check-in; full sweep completed around the area with welfare checks on all stores and businesses open, all clear.
Standing by to show presence while awaiting further response calls. Ending Alpha Route.
Welfare check along Queens Arcade, all clear.
Follow-up check completed along St Pierre Sushi, all clear.
Arrived at the Kiwibank check-in; welfare checks commenced along all stores nearby, all clear.

Arrived at the check-in at the bottom of Fort Street; check-ups made on all stores and businesses within the area, no issues found. Remaining stationed here to ensure a strong security presence while awaiting response calls.
Response call from Glassons head office — no incident occurring, they just needed our company email address. Continuing patrols to the next checkpoint.
Arrived at the Wilson Carpark check-in; follow-up check completed along The Right Track, all clear, no issues found. Standing by to ensure our presence is visible.
Continuing patrols, no activity requiring our assistance.
Stopped and had a word with the staff at Haven Mart Convenience Store, all clear.
Welfare checks completed on all stores and businesses within Lower High Street and Vulcan Lane.
Arrived at Freyberg Place and the Women's Memorial Hall, all clear.
Arrived at the Chancery Square check-in; full sweep completed within the vicinity, no issues found. Standing by to ensure our presence is known.
Continuing patrols, no concerns identified; continuing welfare checks along the Upper High Street stores.
Welfare checks commenced along Lorne Street stores and businesses.
Arrived at the check-in at the corner of Lorne Street and Wellesley Street, no issues so far.
Welfare check along Auckland Library, all clear.
Welfare check along Nandos, Munster Inn and Queens Food Court, all clear.
Making our way back to HQ for a restroom break.
Arrived at HQ; taking a quick restroom break before continuing.
Ending Delta Route and continuing patrols.
Commencing Bravo Route. Arrived at the Aotea Square check-in; full walkthrough completed around the area, no issues found.
Welfare check completed along Metro Entertainment City and Game On, all clear.
Arrived at the check-in at Elliott Street Apartment; welfare check inside Elliott Stables and Atrium on Elliott, all clear.
Welfare check along Chemist Warehouse and Woolworths Victoria Street, all clear.
Commenced welfare checks along Queen Street making our way down.
Stopped into One NZ; standing by outside to show presence while keeping an eye out for any issues.
Welfare check on the static guards along Fort Street, no issues found.
Arrived at the Commercial Bay check-in; full walkthrough around the location completed, all clear. Remaining stationed to ensure a strong security presence before making our way back to HQ.
Arrived back at HQ; commencing lunch break and preparing for changeover to the Afternoon Shift.
Moved away a few individuals from the front of Ippondo.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 21:30)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 2 x Radio, 2 x Bodycam, 1 x Swipe Key.

Received a call from the manager at Jo & Joes regarding a male individual making threatening comments online to a guest. She has sent a photo of the individual, and we are heading over to assist with security presence.

Arrived at the location and received additional information: the individual apparently frequents the "Frenzy" bar crawl, and the guest advised that multiple other females have reportedly been through the same thing.

Spoke to Tyler, one of the organisers of Frenzy, and informed him of the situation. He has the photo of the individual and has blacklisted him from the event. Standing by for security presence in case the individual comes to the hostel.
Fire alarms sounding around the area; continuing to maintain presence.
Fire service has arrived; maintaining presence for any assistance needed.
Fire service has left the area. Full sweep of Fort Lane with welfare checks, all clear; patrolling Fort Street:
Welfare check at Tribe Hotel, Italian Pizza, Smiley Mart, Liquor K, Sal's Pizza and Giapo Cafe, all clear. Standing by at Harbour Suites maintaining presence (15:40–15:55).
Full sweep of Harbour Suites, all clear, no issues. Heading back to HQ.
Arrived at HQ; charging the Ops Phone due to low percentage, shown on the office camera (charging 16:30–16:45).
Received a response call from McDonald's Queen Street regarding a male vagrant outside the premises asking customers for money and disturbing the peace. Gearing up and en route to the location.

Arrived at the location; the vagrant was still posted outside the premises. Approached him and asked nicely to move along. Welfare check at McDonald's Queen Street, all clear. Commencing welfare checks in the area.
Patrolled through Mid City to Elliott Street.
Welfare check at the Atrium on Elliott food court, all clear. Arrived at Elliott Stables, maintaining presence in the area (17:19–17:31).
Welfare check at Elliott Stables and with the guard, all clear. Patrolling to Darby Street.
Welfare check at Celine's and Mali Thai, all clear. Arrived at Darby station, maintaining presence in the area (17:52–18:05).
Full sweep of Darby Street; welfare check at Darby station, all clear.

While patrolling, observed a well-known individual in the area causing a disturbance to the public peace. Approached the vagrant and conducted a welfare check on his wellbeing; he said he was fine, all clear. Standing by for any issues.
No issues confirmed; heading back to HQ to commence a 10-minute break.
Arrived at HQ; commencing a 10-minute break.
10-minute break completed; gearing up and commencing patrols.
Received a call from a fellow guard to let them into the office.
Swiped the fellow guard up; all clear, no issues.
Upper Queen Street all clear; welfare checks on the businesses open, no issues.
Wellesley Street all clear; patrolling Lorne Street.
Welfare check at the Lorne Street staircase centre, all clear.
Full sweep of Lorne Street with welfare checks on the businesses open, all clear, no issues. Patrolling down High Street.
Arrived at Freyberg Place; commencing a sweep of the area.

Received a call from the Irish pub bar on Wellesley Street regarding a male individual who had been removed from the premises being very aggressive towards members of the public and staff, and throwing property off the balcony.
Arrived at the location; no male individual was there causing a disturbance. Standing by in case of any issues (19:27–19:35).
Received a response call from The Fiddler Irish pub regarding a male individual inside the premises causing a disturbance. En route to the location.

Arrived at the location; the male individual was outside Hell's Pizza with a lot of belongings in his possession. Kindly approached and asked him nicely to move along; standing by until the individual and his belongings are off site.
Standing down from Hell's Pizza and The Fiddler; welfare check at 77 Convenience Store, all clear.
Arrived at HQ; commencing a 30-minute break (on break 20:30).
Break completed; on standby awaiting guard handover (20:40–21:15).
Afternoon shift concluded; handing over to the Night Shift.

sections.title: Night Shift (21:30 – 06:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Debrief with the Afternoon Shift completed; charging the Ops Phone before commencing full patrols (charging 21:55–22:10).

Received a response call from McDonald's Queen Street regarding a female vagrant going inside the premises asking many customers for food and becoming very aggressive when denied by members of the public. Gearing up and responding to the call.

Arrived at McDonald's Queen Street; the female vagrant was no longer inside the premises but was seen outside with a group of other vagrants. McDonald's staff notified us that emergency services had been called to issue a trespass notice from the restaurant; standing by until Police arrive.
Police arrived and issued a trespass notice to the female; no further assistance needed. Heading to Bar 101 to maintain presence.
Welfare check along Darby Street, Celine's and Mali Thai, all clear. Patrolling Elliott Street.
Arrived at Bar 101; heavy presence of the public in the area, standing by for any issues.
Removed alcohol from a female individual drinking in public.
Removed alcohol from a group of individuals drinking in public; all clear.
Update regarding the earlier Jo & Joes report: the male individual is continuing to make threatening comments online to the frightened female guest.
Welfare check at Bar 101, all clear, no issues. Heading back to HQ to commence floor checks.
Arrived at the office; commencing floor checks.
Commencing a toilet break before heading out for patrols.
Toilet break completed; heading out for patrols.
Full sweep of Queen Street; welfare check at 77 Convenience Store, all clear. Arrived at Britomart, commencing a sweep of the area.
Full sweep of Britomart; welfare check at McDonald's, all clear. Patrolling Quay Street.
Welfare check at Reign & Pour and with the Kemuri guards, all clear.
Full sweep of Quay Street, all clear. Patrolling the Viaduct area (maintaining presence 01:10–01:20).
Full sweep of the Viaduct; welfare checks at Lulas, Rosies, Dannys and with the guards, all clear. Patrolling through Customs Street to Albert Street.
Customs Street all clear; patrolling up Albert Street.
Welfare check at Albert Mart, all clear.
Albert Street all clear; patrolling through Swanson Street to Federal Square.
Swanson Street all clear; arrived at Federal Square, commencing a sweep of the area (02:05–02:20).
Full sweep of Federal Square, all clear, no issues. Arrived at Ace Karaoke, maintaining presence in the area (02:33–02:45).

Received a call from a fellow guard at Bar 101 requesting Heart of the City presence due to a male individual, possibly intoxicated, waving a stick around members of the public. Routing to the location.
Arrived at the location; no individual was seen in the area causing a disturbance. Maintaining presence in case of any further issues.
Welfare check at Bar 101, all clear. Heading back to HQ to charge the phone.
Arrived at HQ; charging the Ops Phone.
Received a call from the fellow guard at Bar 101 — the same male vagrant swinging a stick around members of the public is back in the area. En route.

Arrived at the location; the male vagrant was spotted. Kindly approached the vagrant and asked him not to disturb the public peace; he was very compliant and no further issues came through. Standing by at Bar 101 maintaining presence.
Welfare check at Bar 101, all clear. Heading back to HQ to charge the Ops Phone.
Arrived at HQ; continuing to recharge the Ops Phone (charging 03:55–04:25).
Received a response call from McDonald's Queen Street regarding a male vagrant sleeping inside the premises. En route to the location.
Arrived at the location; the male vagrant was a well-known individual. Kindly approached and asked him nicely to leave; no issues. Standing by and escorting the vagrant out of the premises.
The individual has left and been safely escorted out of McDonald's Queen Street; welfare checks all clear. Patrolling down Queen Street.
Standing by outside the office to await the Morning Shift guard and swipe them into the office.
Swiped the morning guard up; all clear, no issues. Patrolling down Queen Street.
Full sweep of Queen Street, all clear. Arrived at Britomart, commencing a sweep of the area.
Full sweep of Britomart; welfare check at McDonald's and the public presence, all clear. Heading back to HQ to commence a 30-minute break.
Arrived at the office; commencing a 30-minute break (on break 05:40–05:50).
Break completed; standing by in the office awaiting guard handover (06:15).
Night shift concluded; handing over to the Morning Shift.

flags: SENSITIVE: 14:35 Jo & Joes — male individual making threatening comments online to a female guest (reportedly multiple other females affected); photo circulated, individual blacklisted from the Frenzy bar crawl; 23:31 update notes the online threats were continuing. Threat-of-violence matter involving a third party, not ASG use of force.
SENSITIVE: 00:42 routine Night Shift welfare check at Reign & Pour and the Kemuri guards — all clear, no incident or use of force; noted only because of the separate Reign & Pour matter.
QA: Afternoon Shift concluded at 21:30 (an hour before the nominal 22:30 end) with the Night Shift debrief at 21:40 — the 21:30–22:30 window was covered by the Night team starting early.
QA: Stray raw line '23:31 POI making threatening comments online...' sat between the Afternoon close and the Night header — placed into the Night section at 23:31.
QA: 10:33 Glassons head-office call was administrative only (company email address request) — counted under assist, not calls.
